name: Head of VanCleef
summary: At Sentinel Hill, VanCleef's severed head proves the Defias leader has fallen. Carried from the depths of the Deadmines, it brings the People's Militia hard-won vengeance.

sections.title: Proof of the Master's Fall
sections.body: Westfall's settlers need proof that their danger has passed. For months, Edwin VanCleef directed the Defias Brotherhood's terror from the deepest sanctum of the Deadmines, guarded by armed outlaws, goblin engineers, and a massive war juggernaut. Gryan Stoutmantle, leader of the People's Militia, demands physical proof before declaring the countryside safe. VanCleef's severed head, brought out into daylight, assures the exhausted defenders that the architect of their ruin can no longer threaten Westfall.

sections.title: A Grim Victory
sections.body: VanCleef's death answers Stoutmantle's call for Westfall's good, but the sight of his head carries solemn weight. He was once the revered master builder who rebuilt Stormwind after the First War. Betrayal and unpaid debts drove him and the Stonemasons Guild into outlaw rebellion. His death marks the end of the local militia's campaign and exposes the kingdom's failure to settle its own domestic turmoil. Volunteer farmers and foreign adventurers have been left to carry out high justice.

faq.q: Who wants the Head of VanCleef?
aliases: who do i turn this into
faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle, captain of the People's Militia at Sentinel Hill in Westfall, wants the head to bring the long campaign against the Defias Brotherhood to its close.

faq.q: Why does Gryan Stoutmantle demand his head specifically?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood held Westfall under its grip for so long that rumors of VanCleef's death would not convince the people. Stoutmantle needs physical proof to reassure the beleaguered farmers and show that the militia's struggle was not in vain.

aliases: how to get head of vancleef
faq.answer: The head is taken from Edwin VanCleef aboard his secret ironclad warship, at the very end of the Deadmines beneath Moonbrook in southwestern Westfall.

faq.q: Does taking VanCleef's head end the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: Stoutmantle sees VanCleef's death as the beginning of the end for the brotherhood. Splinter groups, rogue bandits, and sympathizers still linger throughout Westfall, Elwynn Forest, and beyond.

angles.text: VanCleef's head brings the People's Militia a cathartic victory, while exposing the troubling absence of the Stormwind House of Nobles during Westfall's darkest hour.
Edwin VanCleef was one of the deadliest rogue masters in human history. His death ends a peerless career in shadows and sabotage.
